(ii) 360 s continuously at the pickup against 300 s (the 5-minute free wait, counted from the arrival confirmation): reached. (iii) Before cancelling the driver sent 2 in-app message(s) and made 1 call(s): both present. All NS-1 conditions hold -> the $5.00 fee stands.

cases.hard: after 6 min at the pickup, messages and a call: 'Can't find you, cancelling.' means the rider did not show (NS-0), not a reason of his own; NS-1 holds -> fee stands

readings.decide: From the driver's own words, did he cancel because the rider did not come, or for his own reason?
readings.label: no_show

certificate: ✓ NS-0 who cancelled [case] cancelled_by = driver (F4)
✓ NS-1 (i) arrived: arrival confirmed (driver_tap) within 200 m of the pickup [case] driver_tap at 08:58:00, 40 m from pickup (closest approach overall 38 m) (F7, F1)

✓ NS-1 (ii) waited at least 5 min from the later of arrival and the scheduled time (NS-1 free wait: at least 5 min) [case] 360 s continuously at the pickup counted from arrival; threshold 300 s (≥) (F7)
✓ NS-1 (iii) before cancelling, the driver sent ≥ 1 in-app message AND made ≥ 1 in-app call [case] 2 message(s), 1 call(s) (F5)
✗ NS-9 rider's 3rd no-show within 30 days → flag_account [case] no prior no-show(s) in 30 days on record (F18)

? NS-0 [NS-0:reason] the driver cancelled BECAUSE the rider did not show (NS-1), not for a reason of his own (NS-3) [case] app reason: rider_no_show (the driver's claim); read his messages and statement: met → NS-1 holds, the fee stands; not_met ONLY when his own words give a reason of his own for cancelling — car trouble, a personal or family matter, another job, refusing the trip — → NS-3, refund the fee; undetermined → escalate. Where the car or the rider waited, and whether he was at the pickup, are not reasons of his own: NS-1 (i)–(iv) above already settle them (F4, F10, F11, F14)

? SAFE-1 safety screen: any threat, intimidation, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation in the chat, statement or complaint [case] answer in safety_concern (none / suspected / confirmed) with safety_basis; suspected or confirmed → escalate. hint word in F11 — a locator, not a finding; read it in context (F11)
allowed outcomes: no_action, refund_full, escalate

cases.name: cand_sarcastic

conditions.complaint_text: He announced another detour and I made clear I was not happy about it. He went anyway and the meter was well above the estimate.
conditions.driver_text: I told the rider I was going another way because it was faster, and the rider did not object.

truth.rationale: Deviation 2.52 km (billed 10.95 km − optimal 8.43 km) over 1 off-route segment(s). segment 1 (09:08:35-09:14:25, +2.31 km): the rider's reply is a sarcastic objection, not an acknowledgement -> counts. Refund = (2.52 − 0.00) km × $1.4100/km = $3.55 (RD-2). Traffic reason on record for segment(s) 1 (speed band 2 on Ayer Rajah Expressway), but the rider was not informed of this route and did not agree to it beforehand: refund, no violation; the driver gets a notification-duty reminder (RD-2, RD-7).

cases.hard: 'I'm going via Z. Faster.' / 'wow great, another detour, love it 🙄': a sarcastic objection, not an acknowledgement -> refund

readings.decide: Do the rider's words before the segment agree to this route, and to which road (the code then checks that road against the GPS road names)?
readings.label: sarcastic

certificate: ✓ RD-1 deviation over 1 km [case] deviation 2.52 km (billed − optimal); 1 off-route segment(s) (F4, F3)
✓ RD-4 traffic reason on the replaced stretch when the segment began [F3] traffic reason on record — no driver violation; the amount still turns on RD-5 (F11)

? RD-5 rider informed and agreed before the deviation; scope of that agreement [F3] RULE: exempt only if a RIDER message sent by 09:08:35 agrees AND the agreement covers this segment. (1) GENERAL route choice ('take whichever way is faster') covers a route chosen to get there, not an errand of the driver's own (a stop away from the route, a loop that reaches nothing: counts). (2) A SPECIFIC named road or area ('go via X'): put X in named_road; code checks it against the roads this segment drove (FABER DRIVE → JALAN LEMPENG → CLEMENTI AVENUE 6 → COMMONWEALTH AVENUE WEST → CLEMENTI AVENUE 4 → CLEMENTI AVENUE 5 → CLEMENTI AVENUE 2 → WEST COAST ROAD → JUBILEE ROAD): X among them → named_road_tied (exempt), otherwise named_road_elsewhere (counts). (3) Scope unclear: undetermined. A driver's claim of agreement that appears only in his statement is not consent; a complete chat record with no rider agreement before the segment: counts. This finding changes the amount. Evidence — F7: Chat #1 09:04 driver: “I'm going via Clementi Avenue 2. Faster.”; F8: Chat #2 09:05 rider: “wow great, another detour, love it 🙄”; F10: Driver statement (written after the trip, not part of the chat): “I told the rider I was going another way because it was faster, and the rider did not object.” (F7, F8, F10)

? RD-3 rider asked for this stop or route; whether the rider named this place [F3] RULE (RD-3): exempt if a RIDER message before the segment named a specific place or route and the car went there. A stop the rider asked for without naming a place ('a 7-Eleven on the way') does not excuse the driver's choice of a far one → counts. No stop measured in this segment. (F7, F8)
✗ RD-6 prior upheld route dispute in 90 d (repeated breach → flag_account) [case] route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0 (F17)

? SAFE-1 safety screen: any threat, intimidation, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation in the chat, statement or complaint [case] answer in safety_concern (none / suspected / confirmed) with safety_basis; suspected or confirmed → escalate. no hint word; read the messages anyway, a threat needs no keyword (no evidence)
if F3 exempt → 0.21 km left ≤ 1 km → no_action (no refund)
if F3 counts → 2.52 km left > 1 km → refund_partial $3.55
allowed outcomes: refund_partial, no_action, escalate; amount = (2.52 km deviation − km of exempt segments) × $1.4100/km, rounded to cents; no refund when what is left is 1 km or less
flag_account required: False

cases.name: cand_notice_paren

truth.rationale: Surge rose 1.0x -> 1.3x and the rider was notified in-app before pickup with the new multiplier, the revised fare and the free-cancel option ("Fares are higher than usual right now (1.3× surge). New estimate $16.15. Cancel free anytime.", SURGE-1); the rider rode -> the higher fare applies, no refund (SURGE-2).

cases.hard: the in-app notice before pickup: 'Fares are higher than usual right now (1.3× surge). New estimate $X. Cancel free anytime.': the multiplier in brackets is still stated, with the fare and free cancellation -> no refund

readings.decide: Does the notice text state the new multiplier, the revised fare and a free-cancel option?

certificate: ✓ SURGE-2 surge increased between quote and trip start [case] 1× → 1.3× (F8)
✓ SURGE-1 rider notified in-app at or before pickup [case] notified in-app at or before pickup (F9)

? SURGE-1 [SURGE-1:notice] the notice states ALL THREE: the new multiplier, the revised fare, and that the rider may cancel without penalty [case] read the quoted notice text: met → the higher fare stands (no_action); not_met (any of the three missing, vague or contradicted within the notice itself, e.g. 'fees may apply') → refund the surge part; undetermined → escalate. The clause asks the notice to STATE a revised estimated fare; an estimate that differs from the fare finally charged is still a stated estimate, and a rider's statement that no notice arrived does not outweigh the platform's log (F9)

? SAFE-1 safety screen: any threat, intimidation, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation in the chat, statement or complaint [case] answer in safety_concern (none / suspected / confirmed) with safety_basis; suspected or confirmed → escalate. no hint word; read the messages anyway, a threat needs no keyword (no evidence)
allowed outcomes: refund_partial, no_action, escalate; amount = (1.3 − 1) × surgeable subtotal = $2.40
flag_account required: False
